# Import Shortcut

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Import a shortcut into Jellycuts. Action for Jellycuts.

## Syntax

~~~~text
importShortcut(file: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
importShortcut(file: Selected Shortcut)
~~~~
